security_bind_note: WeChat and a phone number can bind to the same account. Either one signs you in, and your data survives a device switch.
security_wechat_unbound_desc: Not bound — bind to sign in with one tap
security_phone_bound_desc: {mask} · signs in with an SMS code
security_phone_unbound_desc: Not bound — bind to sign in by phone
security_password_set_desc: Set — signs in with phone + password
security_password_unset_desc: Not set — quick logins have no password by default
security_unbind_note: Unbinding and rebinding are account-security operations handled by support after verification — please contact customer service.
bind_phone_pitch: Bind a phone to a WeChat account and a simple SMS code signs you in — nothing is lost on a new device.
bind_phone_self: This phone number is already bound to your account
bind_phone_preview_failed: Could not check the number, try again later
bind_phone_conflict_head: This phone number belongs to another account
bind_phone_conflict_body: The bind was blocked and nothing changed. Try signing in with this number's SMS code instead, or unbind it there first.
bind_phone_blocked_cta: Why no auto-merge? See the guidance ›
bind_phone_skipped: Skipped — bind anytime under Account & Security
bind_wechat_pitch: Bind WeChat for one-tap sign-in that survives a phone switch. We only read your nickname and avatar — never your chats.
bind_wechat_skipped: Skipped — bind anytime under Account & Security
bind_wechat_skip_note: Skipping costs nothing — bind later under Me → Account & Security.
bind_wechat_begin_failed: Could not start WeChat authorization, try again
bind_wechat_conflict_head: This WeChat belongs to another account
bind_wechat_conflict_body: — the bind was blocked and nothing changed.
bind_wechat_conflict_note: If it is bound to another account of yours, sign out and sign in with this WeChat instead
merge_summary_empty: No records · no membership · no unlocks
merge_proof_sms:
· A code is sent to the empty account's phone; typing it completes the check
The merge runs only when the checks pass.
merge_proof_wechat:
· You will be redirected to WeChat; this authorization is the check
The merge runs right after the authorization.
merge_proof_switch:
· You will sign in to the main account via WeChat (the same one)
· Then the empty account's phone code completes the check
The merge runs only when both checks pass.
merge_warning: The empty account closes immediately and its phone/WeChat are released; the main account is untouched. This cannot be undone and is recorded.
merge_switch_cta: Switch to the WeChat account and merge
merge_sheet_body: The empty account will be closed and its phone and WeChat released. This cannot be undone.
merge_blocked_body: Both accounts carry data (any of: test records, membership, unlocked reports, referrals). An automatic merge would raise ownership disputes, so it stays closed.
merge_blocked_manual: For a manual merge: submit both phone numbers and an explanation via Feedback; support verifies and handles it offline.
merge_blocked_basis: A merge opens only when exactly one side is empty — no tests taken, no membership, no unlocked reports, no referrals.
merge_switch_failed: Switching to the WeChat account failed, try again
merge_tail_pitch: Signed in to the WeChat account. Enter the original (empty) account's phone and its SMS code to finish the merge.
merge_success_body:
WeChat is bound to this account · the empty account is closed
Sign in with the phone or WeChat from now on
merge_success_line_history: Past tests, reports, and membership window all kept
merge_success_note: Binding status is always visible under Account & Security
pw_set_pitch: You use quick sign-in and have no password yet; set one to sign in with phone + password
pw_change_pitch: Password set — use the new one at the next sign-in
pw_set_no_phone: Setting a password needs a bound phone (the code goes there).
pw_set_send_to: The code goes to your bound phone {mask}
pw_set_note: Change it anytime under Account & Security
pw_change_forgot: Reset it from the sign-in page
pw_error_mismatch: The two passwords do not match
pw_error_generic: Something went wrong, try again later
forgot_pitch: Receive a code on the account's bound phone and set a new password
forgot_code_window: The code is valid for 10 minutes
forgot_note: After the reset, sign in with the password
forgot_done: Password reset — sign in with the new one
